purpose: Relax the official-source requirement for T2 official-channel-gap municipalities while keeping production routing conservative.
allowed_when_all_true: municipality or governorate is in the research queue and has no verified official complaint channel
source is a registered news/official-news target
article identifies a public entity, contractor, or service operator
article includes at least one lifecycle signal: reported, in_progress, reopened, restored, repaired, resumed, cleared, or assigned
location is a public asset, street, municipality, district, or governorate; no private home address is stored
normalized event uses evidence_type=news_followup unless the source is an official agency notice
mandatory_hitl_conditions: safety, fire, collapse, injury, criminal, public-health, or emergency context
conflict, strike damage, unexploded ordnance, security clearance, or army coordination
ambiguous road owner, bridge owner, or highway/local-road boundary
contractor, landfill, plant operator, project-GRM, or procurement boundary
private property or exact household location would be needed to act
privacy_rules: store no names, handles, phone numbers, plates, faces, or private addresses
paraphrase public citizen language; never store comment threads
use municipality/district precision unless the asset is a public road, station, plant, bridge, landfill, or official facility
